name: layered-memory
description: Layered long-term memory for Claude Code, after the four-layer design of TencentDB Agent Memory: raw sessions (L0), extracted facts with supersession (L1), per-project topic scenes (L2) and a user profile (L3). Local SQLite with full-text search, standard-library Python, no proxy and no extra API key: recall at session start, capture and consolidation at session end.
